about.title: About Us
about.subtitle: What is Yerini Ayır?
about.story: Yerini Ayır is an independent local gastronomy discovery guide operated by a natural person. Across 21 provinces and 92 neighborhoods in Turkey, we curate chain-free coffee roasters, neighborhood pizzerias, independent burger spots, breakfast venues, and culinary institutions.
about.what_is_yerini_ayir_text: Yerini Ayır does not process reservations, orders, or payments. Every neighborhood selection follows operational status, strict geographic boundary, and independent non-chain checks, presenting curated menu notes, practical tips, and external map directions.
about.our_goal_text: To highlight neighborhood dining spots chosen by locals and regular patrons rather than generic chains, without adding filler entries when a category has no qualified independent candidates.
about.quote: "In our initial release, we focus strictly on independent local gastronomy discovery with transparent, editorial neighborhood selections."

guide.title: Places to Visit in Turkey & Secret Discovery Routes
guide.subtitle: Turkey's most special corners, local flavours and hidden paradises. Where would you like to explore?

locations.bodrum: An Aegean dream adorned with turquoise bays, white houses and bougainvillea.
locations.samos: A quiet Greek island full of green mountains, turquoise bays and authentic villages.
locations.fethiye: Meeting point of Oludeniz, Butterfly Valley and the Lycian Way.
locations.sirince: Famous Aegean village with historical Greek houses, wines and nostalgic streets.
locations.sapanca: A peaceful getaway route in nature, by the lake and in the forest.
locations.cappadocia: A fairytale atmosphere with fairy chimneys, balloon tours and underground cities.
locations.istanbul: Where continents meet. History, culture, and Bosphorus views.
locations.turkey-guide: Practical tips, entry requirements, and itineraries for first-timers.
locations.antalya: The heart of the Turkish Riviera. Beaches, ancient ruins, and waterfalls.
